policies.rule: No crash-durable outgoing/exposure journal or disk-before-display gate; startup syncs server; admitted work stays durable.
Simple FIFO/TCP and server admission order, no missing-client-number gate or routine acknowledgement waits.
Ordinary reconciliation accepts extra glimpses; no separate disclosure report/barrier or old-context reconstruction.
Existing-game reinvite never revives/replaces a cancelled game; original creation outcome is retained.
Keep compact canonical Stack guard, bounded queues/streaming and actual token destination anchors; D-289 supersedes stronger auth/upload machinery.

New requests respect revocation; already-authorized work may finish. No special reset/commit/rehash races or durable Logout queue; definitions use one ordinary private JSON POST, no upload sessions. Node UUIDs remain locally known.
